title: COMMANDS — price list and campaign commands
summary: Explore of the COMMANDS handler inside the price Functions container: Nexstep/VisionPoint price-list imports and deletes, item-campaign checks/publishing and lowest-price snapshots maintain the price database; campaign changes are published on the price topic. Scheduled triggers (no-layer timer handlers) only enqueue commands. Conceptual only.

sources.note: price.fn.commands handler (q:price) in container func-app; publishes to t:price.
Lines 71–181: COMMANDS subjects: Nexstep/VisionPoint imports and deletes, CheckItemCampaigns, PublishAllItemCampaigns, SaveLowestPriceSnapshot, SaveCampaignLowestPrices.

Before-price design: daily lowest-price snapshot via timer→queue; schedule 07:00/13:00/19:00; campaign before-price after each snapshot; purge >6 months via separate timer; Outlet hardcoded campaign id; API returns before price in campaign price part. Design intent matching timer→queue handlers — not a binding of exact cron expressions beyond this page.
